WssConfig.description:
WebSocket Secure (WSS) transport for remote TUI-to-daemon connections (`[wss]`).

When enabled, the daemon listens for TLS-encrypted WebSocket connections
on the configured bind address and port. TUI clients connect via
`--connect wss://host:port`.

bind.description: Bind address for the WSS listener (default: "0.0.0.0").

cert_path.description: Path to the PEM-encoded server certificate file.

key_path.description: Path to the PEM-encoded server private key file.

description: WebSocket Secure (WSS) transport for remote TUI connections (`[wss]`).
